description: This source file implements a function to generate a position key string for a chess game state, used as a transposition table identifier. It constructs a stable string based on the board layout, castling rights, side to move, and en passant square, to uniquely represent a particular position in the game.

methods.name: positionKey(position)
methods.description: Generates a stable string key representing the current position on the chessboard, incorporating piece placement, castling rights, en passant square, and side to move.
